title: AI Assistant
jd:
About the Company CyanoCorp is an innovative technology company based in Gloucester, UK, focused on developing practical artificial intelligence solutions for businesses across a range of industries. With a collaborative, fast-paced environment, CyanoCorp is committed to nurturing new talent and providing hands-on learning opportunities as the company continues to expand its AI-driven product offerings.
About the Role CyanoCorp is looking for an enthusiastic AI Assistant to join our Gloucester-based team. No prior professional experience is required, making this an excellent opportunity for someone starting their career in artificial intelligence and technology. You will support the wider AI team with day-to-day tasks, helping to prepare data, test models, and assist with the smooth running of ongoing projects, while gaining valuable exposure to real-world AI applications.
Key Responsibilities Assist with data collection, labelling, and preparation for machine learning projects. Support the team in testing and evaluating AI model outputs for accuracy and quality. Help maintain documentation, project trackers, and internal knowledge resources. Coordinate with team members to schedule meetings and organise project materials. Conduct basic research on AI tools, trends, and best practices to support ongoing initiatives. Provide general administrative support to the AI team as needed.
Requirements No prior professional experience required, though a genuine interest in artificial intelligence and technology is essential. Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn new tools and processes. Good organisational and communication skills. Basic computer literacy, with familiarity with spreadsheets and common office software. Ability to work well both independently and as part of a team. A relevant degree or coursework in computer science, data science, or a related field is a plus but not required.
Benefits Structured onboarding and training programme. Mentorship from experienced AI professionals. Opportunities for career progression within a growing company. Modern office based in Gloucester with flexible working options. Pension scheme and standard company benefits. Supportive, inclusive team culture focused on learning and development.
